name: [Yönetim & Kokpit] W12 — Alo Yönetim Haftalık Sistem & Operasyon Kokpiti

parameters.query: SELECT type, COUNT(*) as count FROM "Lead" WHERE "createdAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY type ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Lead" WHERE "isRead" = false) as unread_leads,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "AuditLog" WHERE action LIKE '%incident%' AND "createdAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as weekly_incidents,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "AuditLog" WHERE action = 'application_error_captured' AND "createdAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as weekly_errors,
  (SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))) as db_size,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Post" WHERE published = true) as live_posts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Reference" WHERE published = true) as live_references;
